edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC6 Activity retried or timed out (no legacy source)
    Given a run activity on task queue rwb-partner is started for a partner
    When the activity fails or runs past its timeout and is retried
    Then the retry does not write a second decision record entry for the same run
    Then the activity ends with the last retry outcome and the partner row keeps its previous score when no retry succeeds

  Scenario: AC7 A consumed call fails or does not answer (no legacy source)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock does not answer or returns an error
    When the run reads the ACE score rows
    Then nothing is scored and nothing is recorded
    Then the run stops and the partner row keeps its previous score

  Scenario: AC8 A status change the model does not allow is refused (no legacy source)
    Given a partner row in a status from which the requested change is not allowed by the model
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused and nothing changes
